#### Clase `RequestField` (Línea 126)
- **Docstring:** _A data container for request body parameters.

:param name:
    The name of this request field. Must be unicode.
:param data:
    The data/value body.
:param filename:
    An optional filename of the request field. Must be unicode.
:param headers:
    An optional dict-like object of headers to initially use for the field.
:param header_formatter:
    An optional callable that is used to encode and format the headers. By
    default, this is :func:`format_header_param_html5`._
- **Métodos:**
  - `def __init__(self, name, data, filename, headers, header_formatter)` (Línea 143): Sin docstring.
  - `def from_tuples(cls, fieldname, value, header_formatter)` (Línea 160): A :class:`~urllib3.fields.RequestField` factory from old-style tuple parameters.

Supports constructing :class:`~urllib3.fields.RequestField` from
parameter of key/value strings AND key/filetuple. A filetuple is a
(filename, data, MIME type) tuple where the MIME type is optional.
For example::

    'foo': 'bar',
    'fakefile': ('foofile.txt', 'contents of foofile'),
    'realfile': ('barfile.txt', open('realfile').read()),
    'typedfile': ('bazfile.bin', open('bazfile').read(), 'image/jpeg'),
    'nonamefile': 'contents of nonamefile field',

Field names and filenames must be unicode.
  - `def _render_part(self, name, value)` (Línea 195): Overridable helper function to format a single header parameter. By
default, this calls ``self.header_formatter``.

:param name:
    The name of the parameter, a string expected to be ASCII only.
:param value:
    The value of the parameter, provided as a unicode string.
  - `def _render_parts(self, header_parts)` (Línea 208): Helper function to format and quote a single header.

Useful for single headers that are composed of multiple items. E.g.,
'Content-Disposition' fields.

:param header_parts:
    A sequence of (k, v) tuples or a :class:`dict` of (k, v) to format
    as `k1="v1"; k2="v2"; ...`.
  - `def render_headers(self)` (Línea 230): Renders the headers for this request field.
  - `def make_multipart(self, content_disposition, content_type, content_location)` (Línea 249): Makes this request field into a multipart request field.

This method overrides "Content-Disposition", "Content-Type" and
"Content-Location" headers to the request parameter.

:param content_type:
    The 'Content-Type' of the request body.
:param content_location:
    The 'Content-Location' of the request body.

#### `def format_header_param_rfc2231(name, value)` (Línea 24)
- **Propósito:** Helper function to format and quote a single header parameter using the
strategy defined in RFC 2231.

Particularly useful for header parameters which might contain
non-ASCII values, like file names. This follows
`RFC 2388 Section 4.4 <https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc2388#section-4.4>`_.

:param name:
    The name of the parameter, a string expected to be ASCII only.
:param value:
    The value of the parameter, provided as ``bytes`` or `str``.
:ret:
    An RFC-2231-formatted unicode string.
- **Firma:** `def format_header_param_rfc2231(name, value)`
- **Retorno / Efectos:** Consulta código fuente.

#### `def format_header_param_html5(name, value)` (Línea 95)
- **Propósito:** Helper function to format and quote a single header parameter using the
HTML5 strategy.

Particularly useful for header parameters which might contain
non-ASCII values, like file names. This follows the `HTML5 Working Draft
Section 4.10.22.7`_ and matches the behavior of curl and modern browsers.

.. _HTML5 Working Draft Section 4.10.22.7:
    https://w3c.github.io/html/sec-forms.html#multipart-form-data

:param name:
    The name of the parameter, a string expected to be ASCII only.
:param value:
    The value of the parameter, provided as ``bytes`` or `str``.
:ret:
    A unicode string, stripped of troublesome characters.
- **Firma:** `def format_header_param_html5(name, value)`
- **Retorno / Efectos:** Consulta código fuente.
